name: Jordan Avery
headline: Line Cook · Sauté, Grill and Prep
summary: Line cook with about five years in Portland kitchens, most recently on sauté and grill for a 120-seat bistro. Fast, clean and calm on a full board, and comfortable training new cooks.

experience.title: Line Cook
bullets: Run the sauté and grill stations on a 120-seat line, about 180 covers on weekend nights.
Train new line cooks on station setup, plating specs and ticket times.
Write the nightly prep list and help the sous chef with weekly inventory counts and ordering.

experience.title: Prep Cook, then Breakfast Cook
bullets: Prepped sauces, soups and pastries for a busy breakfast and brunch service.
Moved from prep to the breakfast line within a year; ran the flat-top on weekend brunch.

experience.title: Dishwasher and Prep
bullets: Kept dish and prep moving through rushes and covered prep shifts when the kitchen was short.

projects.name: Seasonal Pop-up Dinners
projects.tech: Menu planning, food costing, local sourcing
bullets: Planned and cooked four five-course dinners for about 30 guests each with a neighborhood supper club.
Costed every menu to a set price per plate and sourced produce from two local farms.

projects.name: Staff Meal Program
bullets: Started a weekly staff-meal rotation built from trim and overstock, which cut down on food waste.

before: I'm applying for the [[Role]] position. I've spent the last two years on sauté and grill at Birch Street Bistro, a 120-seat bistro in Northwest Portland, and I'm looking for a kitchen where I can keep getting faster and learn more.

sections.title: Why [[Employer]]
paragraphs: [[Why this employer: 2 to 3 sentences from brief research about the restaurant, its food and why it matters to me.]]

sections.title: What I'd bring to the line

bullets.text: On weekend nights at Birch Street I run sauté and grill through about 180 covers and keep ticket times on target.
I write the nightly prep list and keep my station labeled and stocked so the next shift starts ready.
I train new line cooks on setup, plating specs and pace.

after: I'm available nights, weekends and holidays, and I can start with two weeks' notice. I'd be glad to come in for a stage or a working interview.
